description: This file manages the state of toolbar popups and layout in the Notesnook project, using Zustand for state management and React hooks for interaction.

classes.name: PopupRef
classes.description: Represents a popup's reference with id, group, pinned status, and optional parent.

classes.name: ToolbarState
classes.description: Defines the state structure for the toolbar, including options, layout, and popup management.

methods.name: useToolbarStore
methods.description: Creates and manages the global toolbar state using Zustand.

methods.name: useToolbarLocation
methods.description: Hook to access the current toolbar location ('top' or 'bottom').

methods.name: useIsMobile
methods.description: Hook to determine if the device is mobile.

methods.name: usePopupManager
methods.description: Hook to manage individual popup states, including open, close, toggle, and pin/unpin actions.
